exact.QUÉ PESA MÁS EN LA ESTIMACIÓN: WHAT WEIGHS MOST IN THE ESTIMATE
exact.Concepto de prototipo: hoy no existe una: Prototype concept: no wristband that measures bone exists today. The SOS of the radius, exercise, and days in microgravity are combined into an estimated index. Bone loss in space is greatest in the hip, spine, and legs; the radius changes little, so it is used as a trend indicator. Sample data.
exact.Puntos del esqueleto con más pérdida óse: Skeleton sites with the most bone loss
exact.Estimación con los días en microgravedad: Estimate based on days in microgravity and the rate measured by the wristband. NASA reports ~1–1.5% loss per month in weight-bearing bones.
exact.Al subir el pulso, el corazón late más r: As the pulse rises, the heart beats faster and harder and the ECG compresses; as it drops, it beats slowly and gently. Frontend-only demo.
exact.Pulsera con ultrasonido midiendo la velo: Ultrasound wristband measuring the speed of sound in the radius
exact.El pulso llega primero a R1 y luego a R2: The pulse reaches R1 first and then R2. Using two receivers cancels out the effect of skin and fluids. If the bone loses mineral, it becomes more porous and sound travels more slowly: the SOS drops.
exact.La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 cara: Password must be at least 6 characters
exact.Cuántas veces late el corazón por minuto: How many times the heart beats per minute. It rises with exertion, stress, fever or dehydration.
exact.En microgravedad la sangre y los fluidos: In microgravity, blood and fluids shift toward the head and the heart works differently. The 2 h of mandatory daily exercise, stress and lack of sleep can raise it.
exact.Cuánto varía el tiempo entre un latido y: How much the time between one heartbeat and the next varies. A high HRV indicates a rested body; a low one, stress or fatigue.
exact.El aislamiento, los turnos irregulares y: Isolation, irregular shifts and artificial light disrupt sleep. That is why HRV is one of the best early indicators of fatigue on long missions.
exact.Qué porcentaje de la hemoglobina de la s: The percentage of hemoglobin in the blood that carries oxygen. It is measured with light on the finger (oximeter).
exact.La cabina mantiene una presión y un oxíg: The cabin keeps pressure and oxygen similar to Earth's. If SpO₂ drops, it usually means a problem with life support, ventilation or the sensor itself.
exact.La temperatura interna del cuerpo. Sube: The body's core temperature. It rises with infections, inflammation or intense exertion.
exact.Estudios en la Estación Espacial midiero: Studies on the Space Station measured that body temperature rises by about 1 °C on long missions (so-called “space fever”): without gravity the body sheds heat less effectively.
exact.En promedio, las mujeres tienen unos poc: On average, women have a few more beats per minute at rest (a smaller heart that pumps less blood per beat). That is why their "normal" limit is slightly higher.
exact.La HRV cambia con la edad, el sexo y el: HRV changes with age, sex and the menstrual cycle. Because it varies so much between people, it is mainly compared against each astronaut's own normal.
exact.En la fase lútea del ciclo menstrual la: In the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle, temperature rises by about 0.3–0.5 °C. A reading of 37.2 °C can be normal then and not indicate fever.
exact.La HR subió de 92 a 118 lpm en 8 minutos: HR rose from 92 to 118 bpm in 8 minutes and stayed high at rest, along with a drop in HRV and SpO₂.
exact.8 min seguidos, ya en reposo: 8 min in a row, already at rest
exact.Dos lecturas de SpO₂ por debajo de 95 %: Two SpO₂ readings below 95% taken 10 minutes apart, with no changes in the cabin.
exact.Señal aceptable (88 %), no parece un art: Acceptable signal (88%), does not look like an artifact
exact.La temperatura subió 0.5 °C en 6 h sin q: Temperature rose 0.5 °C in 6 h without any exercise.
exact.La velocidad del sonido en el radio bajó: Speed of sound in the radius dropped 1.9% in 42 days, more than twice the expected amount, and loading exercise is below plan.
exact.El valor salió del rango normal durante: The value stayed outside the normal range for several consecutive readings.
